zh.title: 协作不互挡，交付按本会话算
highlights: 闲置会话不再长期占住文件。对方进程已退出，或超过 10 分钟没再改且工作区干净时自动接管；对方还在写会先问你。
交付按本会话的改动判断。项目外写入、别人的测试失败和非 git 目录不再造成假红或假绿；自己的回归仍然拦住。
更新先检查再下载，重启前先收好进行中的工作。技能在桌面和命令行共用，改动从新会话生效。
zh.notice: 项目配置里的审批、沙箱豁免和权限规则不再生效，授信也一样。请改到用户全局配置或运行时开关。Linux 渲染修复在本版 AppImage 里，3.28 的包没有这个开关。

en.title: Sessions stop blocking each other
highlights: An idle session no longer holds a file indefinitely. A dead owner, or an exclusive claim untouched for 10 minutes on a clean path, is taken over automatically. A live edit still asks you first.

Delivery follows this session's changes. Writes outside the project, someone else's test failures, and non-git folders no longer fake a red or a green result. Your own regressions still block delivery.
Updates check first, then download, and confirm running work before restart. Skills are shared by the desktop app and the CLI, and changes apply to new sessions.
en.notice: Approval, sandbox bypass, and permission rules in a project config no longer apply, even after you trust the project. Set them in your user config or at runtime. The Linux rendering fix is in this version's AppImage; the 3.28 package does not include it.
